title: &6Act I: &fEmbers
subtitle: Light the first shrine. Call the first Sovereign. Levels 5–15.

quests.title: &e♪ &6The Tale of the Seven
quests.subtitle: Who broke the sun, and why.
description: &6The Keeper&r &e♪
&f&o"Sit. The fire is listening, so I'll keep it short.&r

&f&oThe seven who broke the sun were not monsters, at first. A rider who kept the hours. A king with too many arms. A queen of frost, a lord of storms, a gardener, a burning king, and a wyrm-rider at the edge of the world.&r

&f&oEach took a piece of the light home and swore to bring it back when the Crown called. The Crown never called. The Eighth drank what was left, and the seven went mad in the dark, clutching their scraps of sun like misers.&r
&f&oGather their Fragments. Make a sigil. Wake them. And take back the light they never returned."&r

The &6Sovereigns&r still live, after a fashion. Their light is split into &6Fragments&r and scattered among their &6champions&r. Six Fragments and a token make a &6Sigil&r, and a Sigil calls its Sovereign to wherever you stand.
Each Sovereign you fell rekindles one of the eight embers of the &6Long Eclipse&r.

quests.title: &6Kindling
quests.subtitle: A shrine needs old flame.
description: &6The Keeper&r &e♪
&f&o"Campfire for the heart. Gold for the oath. Deepslate for the bones. And old flame, the kind nothing in this world makes any more. Here. I kept some."&r
An &6Ember Shrine&r is a promise made in stone: that light will be kept here, whatever comes. The first shrines were built by the Sun-Crown's heralds. Almost all of them went cold.
&7An Ember Shrine is a campfire under a crown of gold, set on polished deepslate, lit with &6blaze powder&7. The Keeper gives you the flame. Find the rest.

quests.title: &6Ember in the Dark
quests.subtitle: The first shrine in an age.
description: &6The Keeper&r &e♪
&f&o"There. Do you see it? First fire in an age that wasn't stolen. Last Light, we'll call this place. The dark can count, Ashborn. Let's give it a number it doesn't like."&r
A kindled shrine takes its name from the land around it, the way a candle takes the shape of the room. This one becomes &6Last Light&r: your home, and in time a home to others.
&7Craft the &6Ember Shrine&7, set it down in the village and kindle it. Rest there to heal, refill your &6Ember&7 and &bAzure&7 flasks and bind your respawn. Spend runes there to grow.

rewards.title: The Keeper takes up residence at your shrine

quests.title: Spend Your Light
quests.subtitle: Runes become strength at the shrine.
description: &6The Keeper&r &e♪
&f&o"Light hoarded is light wasted. The Sovereigns learned that too late. Spend yours."&r
At a shrine, runes become flesh. The old heralds called it &oattunement&r: letting a scrap of sun decide what kind of person you'll be.

&7Choose &6Level Up&7. Each rune level raises one of eight attributes (Vigor, Mind, Endurance, Strength, Dexterity, Intelligence, Faith, Arcane) and grants &6RPG levels&7 for your &eK&7 screen. Your armament shows a scaling grade per attribute (&6S&7 to &7E). Feed the ones your weapon loves.

quests.title: Tempered Steel
quests.subtitle: +1 is a beginning.
description: Steel forgets. Tempering Stones remind it: crushed bone-iron from the old forges, pressed into the blade until it remembers being sharp.
&7Tempering Stones take standard armaments up to &6+25&7. The first are cheap: iron, flint and cobbled deepslate. Reinforce your weapon at a shrine.

quests.title: Paths of Ember
quests.subtitle: Two fires, one road.
description: &6The Keeper&r &e♪
&f&o"One fire is a home. Two fires is a road. Ten fires, and the dark starts to feel crowded."&r
Kindled shrines remember each other. Step into one and you can step out of another, as if the light were a single room with many doors.
&7Kindle a second shrine far from the first, then travel between them from the shrine menu. The Remnants Minimap marks every shrine you kindle as a Site of Grace.

quests.title: The Ashen Company
quests.subtitle: They fight for gold, not causes.
description: &6The Keeper&r &e♪
&f&o"The Company? Survivors. They stayed together and they stayed paid, which is more than the Sovereigns managed."&r
The &6Ashen Company&r has no flag, no country and no god. Their captain keeps a ledger of every sellsword who ever drew Company pay, and reads the names aloud on Hunter's Moons.

&7Sellswords loiter near village bells. Use &6gold ingots&7 on one to hire it. Each has a class (Bulwark, Skirmisher, Ranger, Mender, Arcanist), a trait and an epithet it earned somewhere you weren't. Hold &eG&7 for the command wheel; &eU&7 opens your roster and every ally's &6Chronicle&7.
&o"Don't get attached. Or do. They'll be remembered either way."&r

rewards.title: The Company's captain sets up camp at Last Light

quests.title: Proven Hunter
quests.subtitle: Kill something that has died before.
description: An Elite has risen three times. Each death took something human from it and gave back something worse. It carries a blue crest and two traits.
&7Elites pay triple experience, extra loot, a Remnant Shard and bonus Valor. Kill one.

quests.title: Spoils of the Dead
quests.subtitle: The dead hoard.
description: &6The Keeper&r &e♪
&f&o"The dead keep pockets. Habit, I think. Nobody tells them they can't take it with them."&r
Remnants carry what they carried when they died: coin, trinkets, letters to people long gone. The Company calls it &6spoils&r and doesn't ask whose.
&7Monsters sometimes drop &6loot bags&7. Hold use to open one; hold &eShift&7 over a bag for its odds. Four bags of a tier combine into the next, up to &dMythic&7.

quests.title: Into the Dark Places
quests.subtitle: Someone built these to keep things in.
description: Before the Eclipse, the Crown's wardens sealed its worst prisoners underground with cages that bred their own guards. The wardens are gone. The cages still breed.
&7Find a dungeon: a spawner crypt, the catacombs, a frozen vault, a sunken tomb or any other dungeon of the old wardens.

quests.title: The Dungeon Trail
quests.subtitle: Smugglers, mages, warlords.
description: &6The Keeper&r &e♪
&f&o"Every guardian carries a map to someone worse. Nobody knows who started the chain. Nobody's reached the end and come back to say."&r

Four strongholds, four Guardians, one trail of maps. The Company swears the trail was laid by a Sovereign's quartermaster to hide something. The Archivist swears it was a joke. Both have lost people to it.
&7Start with the &6Smuggler's Villa&7 and kill its chief.

quests.title: Champion's Bane
quests.subtitle: Purple rings. Sovereign Fragments.
description: &6The Keeper&r &e♪
&f&o"When a Sovereign went mad, its champions went with it. They still carry their master's light. Take it back."&r

Some foes rise far stronger than the rest: a &5champion&r, marked by a &5purple ring&r and a boss bar of its own, sworn to a Sovereign an age ago and never released from the oath. Champions carry the Sovereigns' &6Fragments&r, the shards of the broken sun: every champion you fell drops one.
&7Kill one.

quests.title: Six Pieces of the Sun
quests.subtitle: A Sovereign answers six Fragments and a token.
description: &6The Keeper&r &e♪
&f&o"The Dusk Rider kept the hours for the Crown. When the sun went out, he stopped his clock at that minute, and he has been riding at that minute ever since."&r

The first Sovereign is the &6Dusk Rider&r, Who Rides When Light Fails: herald of evening, keeper of the Crown's hours. His token is a &6clock&r. He never forgot what time it was when the sun went out.
&7Gather six &6Sovereign Fragments&7 and a clock.

quests.title: A Clock for the Dusk
quests.subtitle: Time, folded into a seal.
description: A Sigil is a Sovereign's own name, pressed into a scrap of their light. Hold it up at dusk and the name remembers who it belongs to.
&7Craft the Dusk Rider's Sigil.
&7The sigil also takes one &6Ashen Alloy&7 (The Ember Forge): the Rider only answers someone who can work a forge.

quests.title: &6Sovereign: The Dusk Rider
quests.subtitle: Who Rides When Light Fails. Level 15.
description: &6The Keeper&r &e♪

&f&o"One ember. Look at it, Ashborn. The first light in an age that came back on its own. Every Ashborn on this world just felt their heart beat a little stronger. That was you. The dark felt it too. It will send something worse."&r
The Dusk Rider still makes his rounds: the same road, the same minute, forever. Break his clock and the evening will finally end.

&7Use the Sigil at night, in the open, with full flasks. He rides; you don't. Roll &othrough&7 the charge, not away from it, and punish him when he turns. If he dismounts, he's angry, not beaten. Felling a Sovereign rekindles one of the eight embers of the &6Long Eclipse&7 and gives every player a permanent heart.

rewards.title: The Smith Under Ash comes to Last Light

quests.title: A Relic Remembered
quests.subtitle: Every Sovereign leaves something behind.
description: &6The Keeper&r &e♪
&f&o"The Smith can make something of that. He says the Rider's glaive still keeps time, if you listen."&r
A Sovereign's &6Relic&r is the part of them that refused to die: the habit they couldn't break, hardened into an object.
&7Exchange the relic at a shrine for its legendary armament, the &6Duskrider Glaive&7.
&7Or keep it: the relic is what binds the &6Seal of Dusk&7 in the Ember Forge, and the seal opens Act II. The sigil calls the Rider again if you want both.
